name: Conservative Consensus CRDT V1
epistemic_strength_order: x <=E y iff x is no stronger than y
crdt_interpretation: Under the reversed safety order, conservativeMeet is the least upper bound.
local_update_rule: CRDT-native local updates must be inflationary in the safety order, equivalently non-strengthening in the epistemic order.
forbidden_native_updates: new exact claim without separate derivation
convergence_claim: Conditional algebraic convergence: replicas that receive the same set of states and merge with the semilattice join converge independent of delivery order and duplicates.
